why: The reviewer's Make Figure 4 button rendered into a random directory under /tmp, under the renderer's default name Figure_ARC_ME_multipanel, so a build that had succeeded left nothing a reviewer could find. It now renders into analyses/Fig4/figure and passes --figure-name Figure_4, and the page reports the master files by full path.

Every numbered script located the tree by walking up to a directory literally named Paper, so an archive unpacked under any other name could not run at all. The predicate now also accepts the directory holding README.txt and scripts/setup; the name is still tried first.
The analyzer's terminal --make-figure path had the same /tmp default and the same unpromoted name.
